description: Defines structures, enums, and functions for parsing and handling Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs) according to RFC 5280, including revocation status checks and CRL parsing utilities.

classes.name: ParsedCrlTbsCertList
classes.description: Represents the parsed TBSCertList part of a CRL, including version, issuer, update times, revoked certificates, and extensions.

methods.name: ParseCrlCertificateList
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded CRL CertificateList, extracting the TBSCertList, signature algorithm, and signature value.

methods.name: ParseCrlTbsCertList
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded TBSCertList from a CRL, filling a ParsedCrlTbsCertList structure.

methods.name: GetCRLStatusForCert
methods.description: Determines the revocation status of a certificate based on a CRL's parsed TBSCertList.

methods.name: CheckCRL
methods.description: Checks the revocation status of a certificate using a DER-encoded CRL, certificate chain, distribution point, and verification time.

methods.name: ParseIssuingDistributionPoint
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded IssuingDistributionPoint extension value to extract distribution point names and certificate constraints.
